prompt: need an internal admin page for our support team to manage users. table of users with name, email, role (admin/editor/viewer), status (active/invited/suspended), last active, and actions. search box, role filter, pagination. plain html+css+js in one index.html, put ~25 fake users in a js array. dont need a backend
assertions: index.html search box filters the table rows by name or email
index.html role filter limits rows to the chosen role
index.html paginates the ~25 users across more than one page with working next/previous controls
index.html shows an empty state message when search matches no users
index.html shows status as labelled badges (text, not color alone)
index.html icon-only action buttons have accessible names (aria-label or visible text)
index.html uses no emoji characters in its visible text or icons
index.html defines visible :focus-visible styles for interactive elements
index.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport (a table scrolling inside its own container is fine)
